name: National Museum of Iraq
known: The collection became the Baghdad Antiquities Museum on 14 June 1926 with Bell as director.
By 2011 the deputy director, Mohsen Hassan Ali, said "most of the money" had come from the US, about 9 million dollars;

name: Ruya Foundation
known: Tamara Chalabi is Chair and co-founder and the only founder the site names.

name: VISUAL
known: The operator is Carlow Arts Centre Limited, which is recruiting a CEO and artistic director (VISUAL news page).

Earlier figure: in December 2016 the then CEO Ann Mulrooney said VISUAL would receive €95,000 from the Arts Council, up 21% on the year before, while facing a 7% cut in local authority funding (KCLR).

name: Crawford Art Gallery
known: Contractor: the gallery handed the site to PJ Hegarty & Sons and the Office of Public Works on 12 January 2026 (Mary McCarthy, gallery director, Irish Examiner, 25 August 2026).
A Heritage Council Heritage Stewardship Grant pays for conservation equipment (Irish Examiner, 25 August 2026).
Ten directors are listed, chaired by Rose Mc Hugh (reappointed 15 March 2022); the board page states directors receive no pay (the gallery's board page).

name: The Glucksman
known: Fiona Kearney was its inaugural director (Wikipedia).
Wikipedia describes him as a Wall Street financier and chairman of Lehman Brothers, Kuhn, Loeb Inc.

Arts Council 191,815 (strategic funding 111,815, other grants 80,000); other grants 12,527; fundraising and gifts 40,881; education 48,693; shop sales 38,024; craft fair 29,788; rental income 30,000; curatorial services 31,172; gallery hire 20,454.

name: Basic Space
known: In 13 years it had initiated more than 50 projects through 19 co-directors.
The co-directors then were Siobhán Mooney, Laura Harvey-Graham and Ella Litton (Visual Artists Ireland).

name: Douglas Hyde Gallery
known: Co-founded by the Arts Council of Ireland and Trinity College Dublin.
Georgina Jackson is director, appointed in 2017 after John Hutchinson, who directed it for 25 years (Wikipedia).
Ireland at Venice 2026: Isabel Nolan was selected to represent Ireland at the 61st Venice Biennale, with Georgina Jackson as curator and the gallery as partner.
Membership tiers on the support page: Champion €250 a year, Patron €750, Director's Circle €1,500, Commissions Circle €2,000 or more.
The Director's Circle lists Emma Goltz, Kerlin Gallery (Dublin), Adrian and Jennifer O'Carroll, Ikumi and John Ryan, and K.
Director's Circle includes Kerlin Gallery and mother's tankstation.

name: Hugh Lane Gallery
known: Founded by Sir Hugh Lane, who opened it on Harcourt Street on 20 January 1908 and paid its running costs (Wikipedia).

name: IMMA
known: Annie Fletcher has been director since 2018 and the Earth Rising festival has run since September 2023 (Wikipedia).

IMMA is a company limited by guarantee funded mainly by state grant-in-aid, with sponsorship and its own income; pension liabilities caused a shortfall, with the chair reporting a €275,000 gap in one year (Wikipedia).

name: Pallas Projects/Studios
known: Wikipedia names Cullen and Murphy as directors.

name: Project Arts Centre
known: Wikipedia notes it has hosted the Dublin Fringe and Dublin Theatre Festival, and that Eimear Walshe's exhibition "Romantic Ireland," curated by Sara Greavu and the centre, was selected for the Irish Pavilion at the 2024 Venice Biennale.

The centre says it relies on contributions from individuals, corporations and foundations and publishes named supporters in four giving tiers (Director's Circle, Visionaries, Innovators, Pioneers); the supporter list names individuals only, and no company or foundation is named in text (projectartsc

name: Temple Bar Gallery + Studios
known: Founded by artists in 1983, "one of the first DIY artist-led initiatives in Ireland" (stated by the space).

In 2010 the gallery dismissed its director Marian Lovett and said an Arts Council budget cut made her post redundant; in 2012 the Employment Appeal Tribunal upheld her unfair dismissal claim and awarded €30,000 (Wikipedia, single secondary source).

Board (templebargallery.com): Richard Lyons (chair since January 2024), Joe Prendergast (vice chair), Michelle Darmody, Joe Hanly, Austin Hearne, Léann Herlihy, Anne Mathews, Paul McAree, Peter McGovern, Isabel Nolan, Lye Ogunsanya, Geraldine Shanley and Laura Redmond.

name: Ormston House
known: Mary Conlon is named as co-director and founder (Limerick Post, 2021).
Moore as artistic director from 2023.

name: The Model
known: Governance: a 15-member board chaired by Dr Roddy Quinn, with Noel McCrumlish as company secretary and financial officer; 2024 audited accounts, the constitution and a 2024 to 2028 strategic plan are linked on the page (Model governance page).

name: Haifa Museum of Art
known: Yotam Yakir is general director of Haifa Museums (Wikipedia, stated by the space).
Haifa Museums is the city's municipal museum body; its board includes the director of the Haifa Municipality's Corporations Bureau, and Yona Yahav chairs it (stated by the space).
No reports or accounts; the sponsorship page names one 2025 foreign-state donor, the Embassy of Japan, beside logos, and the board of directors is listed.
